purpose: Reconcile the 2026-09-01 D100 activation authorization with the later canonical 2026-09-02 fail-closed preregistration gate without inventing scientific specification after activation was requested.

issue_358.title: Activate D100 after D50 30/30 gate PASS
issue_358.requested_action: activate already-defined D100 at next admissible prospective bar

recovery_audit.conclusion: The activation authorization is real, but the asserted already-frozen D100 scientific contract could not be recovered from repository/runtime governance surfaces. The later canonical activation artifact explicitly prohibits inferring the missing six specifications.

decision.reason: Activating now would require inventing or late-freezing one or more of six scientific specifications after activation authorization, which would violate NO_RETUNE/fail-closed governance.
decision.resolution_required: Recover an immutable pre-first-observation D100 contract that supplies all six missing definitions. If such an artifact cannot be recovered, D100 must remain blocked rather than be silently redesigned.
